events.title: Big demo update!
events.summary: Hey everyone!One month ago I release the first demo for Dice Factory. And a lot of you played it!So first of all thank you to everyone who tried the game!It didn't have a lot of bugs but it was missing some keys features and other things were annoying. So I revamped a few aspects to prepare for the Next Steam Fest in October.There are now two dice types, the 6 sided and 4 sided. The 6 sided one is still for the workers, nothing changed. events.title: Thank you!
events.summary: Hello everyone!I want to thank everybody who played in the first Playtest of Dice Factory!I gathered a lot of data about what was good and bad, it will take me a few days to go through everything and be ready for the next step... the demo !I'll post some news about it in the upcoming days :)Stay tuned!mrTodo
